situation: A passport is lost or stolen, either in India or abroad, and the holder needs a replacement, possibly urgently.

remedies_reported.name: Report the loss at the nearest police station and get an FIR or police report
Apply online under re-issue with the reason 'lost', with Annexure F describing how and where it was lost
If abroad, inform the Indian embassy or consulate and ask for an Emergency Certificate to return to India
Use Tatkaal if the passport is damaged but still legible

conflict_note: The guide talks about a 'duplicate' passport. Passport Seva says no duplicates are issued, only a new passport with a new number. Tatkaal is not available for lost or stolen passports, only for damaged ones that are still legible.

source.title: Royal Sundaram: Lost or stolen Indian passport, what to do next

your_summary: An insurer's guide to losing a passport. It says to report to the police first, then apply for re-issue with the police report and a loss affidavit, or get an Emergency Certificate abroad. It loosely calls the replacement a duplicate, which the official FAQ says does not exist.
